rating.label: Average onboarding rating / Prosecna ocena onboardinga

items.name: Milena J.
items.text: The process was clear and fast. I received direct trainer feedback and started teaching shortly after approval. / Proces je bio jasan i brz. Dobila sam konkretan feedback i brzo krenula sa casovima.

items.name: Nikola P.
items.text: Flexible scheduling helped me combine classes with my full-time obligations. The platform support team was responsive during onboarding. / Fleksibilan raspored mi je pomogao da uskladim posao i obaveze.

items.name: Ana S.
items.text: I joined while studying and built a stable monthly routine. The two-phase process set clear expectations from day one. / Prijavila sam se tokom studija i izgradila stabilan mesecni raspored.
